card.name: Linking words in drug-interaction text
card.fires_on: Small connecting words in drug-label sentences about interactions or dosing, such as therefore, however, may, either and see. They often come just before a comma or a cross-reference.

modes.label: Connectors after a semicolon
modes.description: Therefore or however right after a semicolon, before a comma.
modes.example: may increase ensartinib exposure;<< however>>, this has not been studied clinically.

modes.label: Words before a cross-reference
modes.description: See, Table or ADMIN in a bracketed pointer to another label section.
modes.example: For administration instructions,<< see>> Dosage and Administration ( 2.

modes.label: Either before drug
modes.description: Either in the phrase either drug when comparing or monitoring two drugs.
modes.example: during upward dosage titration of<< either>> drug.
